note: Report coverage pins that a human has re-verified by reading after the cited dossier moved past the pin. One entry per (report, slug). verifiedAt is the dossier profileVersion the pin was verified against; pinnedVersion is what the report still carries. Superseded reports are not tracked here (the checker skips their pin drift). Record: PROFILER-COVERAGE-PLAN.md §9.3 (X3b).
